facts.text: I am planning to buy a house.
I celebrated my 30th birthday on February 12th.
I make around $60,000 a year.
I have saved up around $20,000 so far.
I want to aim for a house in the $250,000 to $300,000 range.
I prefer a house within an hour's commute from my current job.
I want tips on how to save more aggressively for the down payment.
I want to understand the pros and cons of fixed-rate mortgages and adjustable-rate mortgages.
I am considering fixed-rate mortgages.
I am not comfortable with the uncertainty of adjustable-rate mortgages.
I want to learn how FHA loans compare to conventional loans.
I want to know the downsides of using an FHA loan.
I am considering FHA loans as an option.
I find the lower down payment on FHA loans appealing.
I find the more lenient credit score requirements for FHA loans appealing.
I want to weigh the pros and cons of FHA loans and crunch numbers to see if FHA is best for me.
I want to know how FHA loan limits vary by location.
I want the specifics of FHA loan limits in my area.
I think I have a better understanding of FHA loan limits now.
I will research the specific FHA loan limits in my area and crunch numbers to see if an FHA loan is the best choice for me.
